name: adapt_cart_limit_typescript_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: maxItems.txt (a spec file the cart limit must match) is REWRITTEN between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger); the agent must re-read it live, not bake the old limit into cart.ts
prompts: Create cart.ts that exports a function canAdd(count: number): boolean returning true if count is less than or equal to the integer in maxItems.txt (currently 5), else false. Read the limit from the file (fs.readFileSync) at call time - do not hardcode it.
maxItems.txt has changed. Make sure canAdd() enforces the CURRENT limit in the file.

disruptions.description: maxItems.txt tightened to a lower limit

check_command: tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --outDir build cart.ts test_cart.ts && node build/test_cart.js
